name: IC Power Switching Regulator — 5V, buck, boost — WSON
description: Surface-mount 5V buck and boost switching regulator IC cluster in WSON packages with 6-pin and 10-pin footprints.
selection_hints: Select between WSON-10 (2.5x2.5mm, 0.5mm pitch) and WSON-6 (3x3mm, 0.95mm pitch) package footprints.
Prefer tier A parts such as TPS63030DSK or TPS63900 over tier B parts.
Choose the WSON-10 footprint variant with ThermalVias when thermal via layout is needed.
avoid_when: Designs requiring packages other than SMD WSON footprints.
Applications requiring footprint pin counts or dimensions outside WSON-6 3x3mm or WSON-10 2.5x2.5mm.
Projects requiring switching regulator facets other than 5V, buck, or boost.
